meta.name: add-webex
meta.description: Add Webex channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Webex 聊天通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用中添加 Webex 消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat channel into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex messaging to your application

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能为项目添加 Webex 聊天通道：复制适配器、注册、安装固定版本依赖并运行构建和测试。凭据配置完成后，可在 Webex 空间收发消息。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加或接入 Webex 渠道，或在 /setup 初始化流程中需要启用 Webex 时触发。

say.text: 给项目添加 Webex 通道集成。
say.note: 技能会复制适配器、注册并安装依赖。

say.text: 接入 Webex，我会提供机器人令牌和 webhook secret。
say.note: 技能会提示你输入这些值并写入 .env。

say.text: 为当前项目启用 Webex 支持并运行测试。
say.note: 技能会执行构建和集成测试。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can add Webex channel support to the project: copies the adapter, registers it, installs a pinned dependency, and runs build and integration tests. Once credentials are set, it can exchange messages in Webex spaces.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add or integrate Webex, or when Webex needs to be enabled during the /setup flow.

say_en.text: Add Webex channel integration to the project.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, and installs the dependency.

say_en.text: Connect Webex, I'll provide the bot token and webhook secret.
say_en.note: Prompts you to enter these values and writes them to .env.

say_en.text: Enable Webex support for the current project and run tests.
